tools.name: check_dependencies
tools.description: Check all required and optional dependencies for the paper writing assistant. Reports what's installed, what's missing, and install hints.

tools.name: lean_formal_edges
tools.description: Extract ELABORATED formal dependencies between a folio's lean.ref declarations (LeanArchitect's rule over the folio's own lean.ref set; no attributes, no LeanArchitect). Needs a Lean toolchain and a built Lake project. Tagged declarations missing from the build are reported, never recorded as dependency-free. With ingest=true the result is recorded in the formal cache as source "elaborated".

lake_dir.description: The folio's Lake project directory (holds lakefile.* and .lake/)

root.description: Content root to collect lean.ref targets from (default: the folio's declared one)

ingest.description: Record the result in the formal cache as source "elaborated"

tools.name: paper_preferences
tools.description: Get or set user rendering preferences. Preferences persist across sessions in .folio-prefs.json. Set action='get' to view current, 'set' to update, 'reset' to restore defaults.

action.description: Action: get current, set values, or reset to defaults

auto_preview.description: Automatically open in browser after render

default_chapter.description: Default chapter to render when scope=chapter

print_mode.description: Print mode: formal (affiliations, expanded) or compact (dense, no affiliations)

compact_inline_refs.description: In compact mode, include examples/remarks directly referenced by blocks in the view

tools.name: paper_preview
tools.description: Open a rendered PDF or HTML file in the system browser. Lists available renders if no specific file is given.

file.description: Specific file to open (path relative to build/ or absolute)

format.description: Filter by format when listing available renders

list.description: Just list available renders without opening
